maintenance_state: Snapshot release, last commit 30 Oct 2026; Apache-2.0. Not a maintained library: ComparatorChallenges file keeps the statement with sorry, solution lives in OAI namespace under a ~640-file QuantumFactoring directory. The complete proof is in the repo (Main.lean has no sorry).
notes: Circuit model is a concrete gate-level model with fixed 20 gate names, Boolean-wire basis Basis q := Fin q -> Bool, State q := Basis q -> C, circuit applied by foldl of matrix mulVec. There is no query oracle in this model other than classical Boolean networks compiled to reversible circuits (BooleanNetwork, phaseOracle), no Walsh-Hadamard n-fold lemma beyond hadamardAt on one wire, and no Grover/minimum finding. Useful as a design reference for exact-gate circuits and as evidence that the target Lean toolchain (v4.34.1) matches what OpenAI used; the file ExactQuantumFactoring.lean is the challenge only. Directory listing was via contents API; recursive tree was truncated so file inventory is from directory listing.
